title: Corank estimates without radial restrictions
source_hypothesis: Ordinary smooth embedded conic canonical relation, closed in the full joint puncture and excluding both covector axes. No individual radial-vector exclusion; variable rank and zero shared block allowed. Scalar universal necessity requires a nonzero input/output bundle component.
component_scope: Full ordinary radial-free sufficient m<=-k(c)/4 and universal necessary k(c)<=-12m estimates, exact affine quantizations and annular kernels, strong dyadic recombination, fixed-operator cubic necessity and all-real sufficient Sobolev shifts.
